readerTruth.AppClip: App Clip offers an event or calendar-invitation preview. Adding through this experience requires the full app. Do not imply universal automatic launch, no-install adding, direct calendar save or automatic installed-app handoff.
readerTruth.emailAndQR: Email and QR invitations use web landing routes offering the full app. These are not interchangeable App Clip invocations or ICS subscription URLs. QR conveys a link, not the recipient’s identity.
readerTruth.singleEventAdd: Full-app event import requires calendar permission and a writable destination; permission/absence/save failure are possible. Some single-event reception can be recorded anonymously, so do not blanket-assert signed-in verified identity for every preview or event copy. Elevated email-assigned access depends on the intended identity.
readerTruth.wholeCalendarAdd: Whole-calendar acceptance uses a signed-in app-sharing session and verified email identity; recipient identity affects resulting Reader/Writer/Owner role. A browser or App Clip preview is not completed acceptance.
readerTruth.sender: Synchronized event-sharing creation uses sign-in/feed guards; do not imply every sender can share without an account.
readerTruth.separateResults: Viewing details, saving a copy, subscribing to an ICS feed, accepting calendar access and responding to an invitation are distinct. Reception/acceptedAt is not an attendance RSVP.

boundedSuggestedCopy.event: App Clip previews the event. To add it through this experience, use the full app and choose a writable calendar.
boundedSuggestedCopy.calendar: Preview the invitation, then use the full app to sign in, accept the calendar and check your access.
boundedSuggestedCopy.delivery: Email and QR invitations can open a web preview with an option to continue in Cloud Calendars.
